source_message:
feat: ChatGPT Actions sync — OpenAPI export script + sync checklist

- scripts/export-openapi-schema.sh: exports OpenAPI schema from compliance API
  (port 8090); tries live API, falls back to temporary uvicorn; generates
  docs/CHATGPT-ACTIONS-SPEC.md with endpoint table and import instructions
- docs/CHATGPT-SYNC-CHECKLIST.md: step-by-step checklist for syncing ChatGPT
  Custom GPT (Actions schema, System Prompt, Knowledge files, end-to-end tests)

Note: bridge_api.py not present in vibe-coding (port 8092 = separate project);
this targets the main compliance API (api.py, port 8090, banxe-api.service).
